newsitem.title: INDIA: India NALCO aims 800,000 T alumina output in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: India NALCO aims 800,000 T alumina output in 97/98.

text.p: India's state-run National Aluminium Company (NALCO) said on Thursday it plans to produce 800,000 tonnes of alumina and 218,000 tonnes of aluminium in 1997/98 (April-March).
NALCO said in a statement it planned to sell 218,000 tonnes of aluminium in 1997/98 both domestically and overseas. It also planned to export 375,000 tonnes of alumina in 1997/98.
The company signed an agreement with the Mines Ministry on Thursday on the production and sales targets, the statement said.
NALCO, Asia's largest aluiminium maker, produced 192,288 tonnes of aluminium in 1995/96 (April-March) against 178,072 tonnes in the previous year.
It has a domestic market share of 35 percent.
